findings.evidence: Lines 23–27 make both contradictory claims; `isJordanCurve_frontier_of_convex` at line 313 is explicitly specialized to `Set ℂ`.

findings.evidence: Lines 138–143 take `ho` and `hb` separately and populate four fields: `isOpen`, `isConnected`, `isBounded`, and `isJordanCurve_frontier`.
